text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Poker Tournament: Final Showdown"...!? 
We're inside a department store, right...? 
Could it be that I—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"I got lost again"... is that it? This 
ain't no place for a little lady. Scram.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
N-Nakayama-san!! Um... I want to go home 
too, but I'm lost...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
......*sigh* Listen, don't you dare look 
at my hand. If you can promise that――wait 
inside.

text_block_list.name: Poker Player
text_block_list.text:
"...I raise! Come on, Nakayama, what're 
you gonna do?!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(If I remember right, the rule was you bet 
coins instead of points... and whoever had 
the highest score at the end won, 
right...)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(My opponent looks so confident... Could 
they be holding an insanely strong 
hand—?!)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —Raise.

text_block_list.name: Poker Player
text_block_list.text:
"...Pfft, ahahaha! Thanks, missy! Great 
expression! That raise is a total 
bluff—today's my day to win!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Huh... I'm so sorry, Nakayama-san! I-I 
just couldn't help myselfâ!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
No problem――we keep going like this. We'll 
haul it all up in one go.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Really?! I didn't see either of 
your hands, but your opponent looked 
really strong, you know...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... That's right, you haven't looked at 
your hand. Yet, your opponent thinks 
they've already won. From here on out, 
it's going to be a battle of raises.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"The pot keeps swelling... Haha... It's 
thrilling to the absolute max! I'll crush 
them head-on—and take it all!"

text_block_list.name: Poker Player
text_block_list.text:
Gwaaaah! She kept raising right to the 
bitter end... Is she out of her mind!?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
W-We won...! Nakayama-san, did you know 
what cards they were holding?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Like hell that's true. —They just went and 
jumped to their own conclusions.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...You're truly strong under pressure. 
Though with all those raises, you had me 
on edge..."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Making a bold move without fear... Perhaps 
that's what paved the way to victory!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps she had gotten the hang of making 
her move. From that day on, Buena Vista's 
running grew even sharper.
